items.section: The Ninja caveat: registered does not mean executed
items.text: No workflow evaluates a ModuleLinkClosure_* contract against a real link line: scripts/check_module_link_closure.py reads CMakeFiles/<target>.dir/link.txt and exits 77 (SKIP) without it; the only workflow that runs an unfiltered ctest (general-tests-ci.yml) configures with -G Ninja, and the Makefiles-default lanes (devices-tests, apple-ci, metal-macos-ci) never run these tests. Its OPENGLES3 configuration also registers neither the HEADLESS native-SDK-free nor the Vulkan closure gates.

probe_core's forbid pattern (libcna_(?!core|math)|libCNA_|libenet|libav|cna_renderer_) does not forbid libSDL3, and its comment still says SDL3 is an accepted private detail of Logger.cpp, whereas modules/core/CMakeLists.txt states core no longer includes or links SDL; an SDL link re-entering cna_core would pass the gate.

modularization/tools/check_include_reachability.py and check_header_self_containment.py hard-code the August 2026 module graph (14 framework modules, no platform/diagnostics/design/phone/inspector/content-pipeline/video-ffmpeg/c-api, a pre-curation renderer map) and are referenced by no CMake file, CTest registration, workflow or script; by reading, the reachability table cannot reach the platform module from runtime, graphics, input or audio sources that include CNA/Platform headers.
items.evidence: modularization/tools/check_include_reachability.py (PUBLIC, PRIVATE, FAMILY tables); check_header_self_containment.py; grep of cmake/, .github/workflows/, scripts/

items.section: The migration was checked as a no-loss transformation
items.text: metal-macos-ci.yml's push paths filter lists cmake/BackendLibraries.cmake, cmake/Examples.cmake and cmake/Tests/MetalTests.cmake, none of which exists, and omits modules/renderers/metal/CMakeLists.txt and modules/renderers/metal/examples/CMakeLists.txt, where the Metal tests are registered; a push that changes only Metal registration does not start the workflow (pull requests are unfiltered).
items.note: The three dead paths are already noted in fact sheet 02 (C3); the missing Metal CMake paths are the new part.

items.text: cmake/toolchains/mingw-w64.cmake falls back to the i686-w64-mingw32 compiler when the x86_64 one is absent but keeps CMAKE_SYSTEM_PROCESSOR x86_64, so the persistent SDL install key (.sdl-prebuilt-Windows-x86_64) mislabels a 32-bit toolchain; its header comment still requires pre-built SDL on CMAKE_PREFIX_PATH although the vendored SDL is built for the target at configure time.
items.note: Consequence (reuse of a mismatched SDL install) is inferred, not observed.

items.text: Documentation drift inside CNA: the tests preset description in CMakePresets.json (and the README) still asks for 'git submodule update --init --recursive', names four submodules (omitting draco) and refers to '.sdl-prebuilt/', contradicting cmake/ThirdPartySDL.cmake's non-recursive instruction and the keyed prebuilt root.

In a MinGW-w64 cross tree CnaTests receives a CROSSCOMPILING_EMULATOR (a Wine wrapper) only when the default renderer is DIRECTX9, DIRECTX11 or DIRECTX12 or DIRECT2D is compiled in; for any other default (for example SDL_RENDERER) gtest discovery and CTest would try to execute the Windows binary on the Linux host.
items.note: By reading; depends on whether the host hands PE files to Wine via binfmt_misc.

items.section: The Ninja caveat: registered does not mean executed
items.text: The link-closure tests pass --build-dir ${CMAKE_BINARY_DIR} while the probe targets are defined in CNA's own root directory; when CNA is added as a subproject with tests on, the checker looks for CMakeFiles/<probe>.dir/link.txt in the consumer's root and always skips.

items.section: The module factory and one public include root
items.text: Stale comments: the cna_add_module comment says the only headers under src/ are renderer-local shader headers (module-private src/ headers are common, and renderers include modules/platform/src); ModuleProbes.cmake's header still speaks of 42 public identities; probe sources name their gates ModuleLinkClosure_Storage and similar while the registered names carry the probe_ prefix.

The source-partition validator globs only *.cpp and *.mm and checks path prefixes: headers and C sources outside every module are not reported, and a translation unit in a subdirectory of a renderer family's src/ passes the check but is never compiled by the non-recursive cna_add_renderer glob.

sharp-runtime's FileSystemWatcher.hpp declared inotify fields outside its __linux__ guard, surfaced by an Emscripten build and reported fixed in sharp-runtime; a sibling-repository defect, not a CNA one.

No current gate compiles each public C++ header of the framework modules in isolation: ContractIsSdlFreeTests compiles all platform contract headers in one TU and CApiHeaderCompatibility covers only the C headers.

Android has no preset, workflow, CMake API-level check or test route; the only Android build project is the Devices demo (NDK 30.0.14904198, API 24, arm64-v8a) which forces tests and examples off, so an Android build is compile-only evidence.
No workflow configures CNA_BUILD_C_API=ON, so whether the 0.29.0 C API library builds and installs at TARGET is unverified; CApi_InstalledConsumer is registered in source only.
